entries.title: Insights consent priming capture.
entries.notes: Runner-only warm-up capture that dismisses the Insights consent banner before marketplace-facing Hero screenshots are taken.
entries.useCase: The screenshot runner sets anonymous visitor consent state so Hero captures do not include analytics consent chrome.

entries.title: Hero home widget rendered on a public page.
entries.notes: Runs capell:hero-setup --force before capture and waits for the public home page to render the Hero widget.
entries.useCase: A visitor sees the seeded hero widget rendered through Layout Builder and the active frontend theme.
